implemented: Instrument rules are effective-dated and carry tick, lot, multiplier, settlement lag, order/freeze limits, exchange, margin/session rule identities, session window and source lineage.

Order validation selects the historical rule effective on the order date and rejects missing source facts, wrong exchange, non-lot quantity, freeze-limit excess, off-tick price, and outside-session time.
Order validation now also rejects suspended, delisted or expired instruments using date-effective status/expiry gates before permitting a paper order.
Regression tests confirm suspended and expired contracts are refused without mutating or repairing order inputs.
